title: Acme Widgets: modular widgets for small workshops
description: Acme Widgets designs modular, repairable widgets for small workshops, with open dimensions and spare parts kept in stock for ten years.
body: Every Acme widget is built from the same twelve parts, so a workshop can repair, extend or resize it with a screwdriver.
Our customers are woodworking, bicycle repair and electronics workshops with fewer than ten people.
